description: Asks which Automation inputs a QueryDef parameter admits and what the query returns for each: a declared Long and a declared Text parameter, and an undeclared parameter [pv], each set to Null, Empty, the optional-argument marker (VT_ERROR DISP_E_PARAMNOTFOUND), an empty BSTR, a BSTR with an embedded U+0000, a lone-surrogate BSTR and ordinary typed values. Also asks the failure of a fresh declared-parameter QueryDef opened without a value. Parameter Name and Type are read from the Parameters collection. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.

args.text: PARAMETERS pl Long; SELECT pl AS v, IsNull(pl) AS n, pl + 1 AS s FROM One
PARAMETERS pt Text; SELECT pt AS v, IsNull(pt) AS n, Len(pt) AS l, pt & '|' AS c FROM One
SELECT [pv] AS v, IsNull([pv]) AS n FROM One
PARAMETERS pl Long; SELECT pl AS v FROM One
